description: This source file defines the class TransactionCommitterAttributeMapper which implements IAttributeToFactoryMapper for TransactionCommitterAttribute; it maps attributes to factory functions for transaction committers in Orleans.

classes.name: TransactionCommitterAttributeMapper
classes.description: Internal class that maps TransactionCommitterAttribute to corresponding factory functions within Orleans transactions.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a factory delegate based on the provided parameter info and attribute.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Invokes the factory method to create an instance of a transaction committer.
